newsitem.title: JAPAN: Strong chip data boosts Advantest for second day.
newsitem.headline: Strong chip data boosts Advantest for second day.

text.p: Shares in Advantest Corp, a maker of semiconductor testing devices, rose for the second straight day on Wednesday, inspired by bullish book-to-bill figures announced earlier in the week, brokers said.
At 0536 GMT, the shares were up 70 yen at 4,450 yen.

However, chip shares such as NEC Corp were battered by profit taking. The shares were down 10 yen at 1,310 yen, the eighth most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange with volume of 3.508 million shares.
The Semiconductor Industry Association said on Monday that the U.S. semiconductor book-to-bill ratio rose to 1.10 in October from a revised 0.98 in September.
